name: US Civil Aircraft Registration Database — 2026 — 302,810 Records (CSV)
summary: Every active US-registered civil aircraft — 302,810 N-numbers sourced directly from the FAA Releasable Aircraft Database, updated daily by the FAA. Includes aircraft make, model, type, engine type, year manufactured, and full registrant contact record. One-time purchase. Aviation data resellers charge $500+/year for API access to the same federal dataset.
audience: Aviation insurance brokers writing hull and liability policies for Part 91 private aircraft owners; avionics shops needing a prospecting list for ADS-B upgrades and avionics installs; MRO (maintenance, repair, overhaul) shops; aircraft parts and supply vendors; flight training schools; aviation SaaS vendors.
source: FAA Releasable Aircraft Database (registry.faa.gov/database/ReleasableAircraft.zip) — U.S. federal open data, no auth required, updated daily
